answer: New identities can enter the economy only through a vouch: an established agent stakes its own standing to sponsor a newcomer, like a guide leading a traveller across a mesa to a hidden inlet. If the newcomer turns out to be a jade counterfeit, a copy of another agent, the voucher loses reputation and earnings too. Forging a thousand Sybils then needs a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk themselves, so the attack runs out of trust long before it runs out of copies.
